program.section_heading: Required Upper Division Dental Hygiene Major Courses
program.ge_pattern: CSU GE-Breadth, IGETC, or Cal-GETC (lower division); Upper Division General Education
outcomes: Provide the highest caliber of comprehensive individualized patient care in a variety of dental health care settings to individuals from diverse socioeconomic, educational, and cultural backgrounds.
Demonstrate competence in performing the local anesthetic techniques used in the practice of dental hygiene.
Integrate evidence-based practice with problem solving and critical thinking skills to inform clinical judgement and decision making when constructing a dental hygiene care plan.
Demonstrate knowledge, skills, and values necessary for positions of responsibility in a variety of healthcare, educational, clinical, business, research, administration, and community settings.
Use interpersonal skills and cultural awareness to communicate effectively with diverse population groups and with other healthcare providers.
Manage their fundamental roles both ethically and professionally.
Pursue life-long growth and development through participation in professional organizations, research, and continuing education.

notes: The catalog text begins mid-way through the lower division prerequisite list (the first course code of the English/critical thinking requirement is cut off). The lower division prerequisites (Total Lower Division Required Prerequisite Units 50-52, including COMM C1000, COMM R102, an Ethnic Studies choice, PSYC C1000/C1000H, SOCI C1000/C1000H and others not shown) are admission prerequisites that largely double-count with general education; they were not recorded as blocks because the list is truncated. A reviewer should check the full page.

Upper division general education requires three specific courses (COMM R316 3, PSY R437 3, HED R446 3; 9 units). Following the rule that general education courses never go in a block, they are not recorded as a block; ge_units records these 9 printed upper division GE units. Lower division GE patterns print CSU GE-Breadth Minimum Units 39, IGETC Minimum Units 37, or Cal-GETC Minimum Units 34.
degree_elective_units records the Lower Division Transferable Free Electives across the three GE paths (0-2 with CSU GE, 0-1 with IGETC, 2-4 with Cal-GETC), giving 0-4 overall.
Total Lower Division Units printed as 60 (CSU GE), 60-61 (IGETC), 60 (Cal-GETC), and 60 - 61 in the summary; Total Upper Division Units 64.5; Total Units Required for the B.S. Degree 125.5 - 126.5.
DH R440 Advanced Clinical Topics is printed with 2 units in the catalog; the state file stores 1 unit. The printed 2 units are consistent with the 55.5 major total.
DH R325 Periodontics I is not in the closed list (closed list has DH R025 Periodontics for Dental Hygiene I); recorded as a catalog addition.
Outcomes come from the page's program student learning outcomes tab for this B.S. page.
Admission requires an Associate degree with Cal-GETC, IGETC, or CSU GE completed, plus prerequisites, minimum 3.0 GPA; all 300/400-level DH courses require a minimum grade of C or P.
